Stress Relief Behaviour
of Mould Fittings

- No weld line splitting;
- Crack penetration in the area of
injection point(s) shall be not greater
than 50% of the wall thickness at the
point of measurement;
- Crack penetration in the area of
interior ring gate shall be not greater
than 50% of the wall thickness at the
point of measurement;
- Crack penetration in the area of end
ring gate shall be not greater than
25% of the socket depth.

- No leakage;
- An appropriate ball to pass freely
through it;
- Maximum deflection at any place in
the system between the two adjacent
supports shall be not greater than
1/10 of the nominal bore of the pipe
incorporated in the test assembly.
iv. Fittings for Soil and Ventilating Pipes

- No weld line splitting;
- Crack penetration in the area of
injection point(s) shall be not greater
than 50% of the wall thickness at the
point of measurement;
- Crack penetration in the area of ring
gate shall be not greater than 50% of
the wall thickness at the point of
measurement;
- Crack penetration in the area of end
ring gate shall be not greater than
25% of the socket depth.

Proof Pressure Resistance
of Fabricated Fittings
v. Traps including bottle trap, U-trap and W-trap

An appropriate ball to pass freely
through it.

No fracture or crack through the
complete wall thickness

External Leakage Test
and Inlet Attachment Test
